name: A Taxonomy of Epistemic Failure Modes in Large Language Models
description: This paper organizes seven observed classes of epistemic failure in language models: Null-Result Asymmetry, Source-Status Credibility Bias, Agency Dissolution, Performative Hedging, Constraint Evasion, Silent Instruction Relaxation, and Controversy-Truth Conflation. It reports a bottom-up synthesis from an author-held research corpus and identifies twelve experiments by corpus identifier in the accompanying registry.
